mapper.sql: a.id as id ,a.fabuzhe_id as fabuzheId ,a.fabuzhe_table as fabuzheTable ,a.fabuzhe_role as fabuzheRole ,COALESCE( a.fabuzhe_name, CASE WHEN a.fabuzhe_table = 'xuesheng' THEN xuesheng.xuesheng_name WHEN a.fabuzhe_table = 'laoshi' THEN laoshi.laoshi_name WHEN a.fabuzhe_table = 'qiye' THEN qiye.qiye_name WHEN a.fabuzhe_table = 'users' THEN users.username ELSE '' END ) as fabuzheName ,a.taolun_title as taolunTitle ,a.taolun_content as taolunContent ,a.create_time as createTime ,a.update_time as updateTime ,(select count(1) from taolun_huifu th where th.taolun_id = a.id) as replyCount
